memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Glaucoma, vitamin D deficiency, and insomnia are stable.
Evidence: IOP 18 mmHg OD, 19 mmHg OS; visual field full; optic disc cupping 0.4. Serum 25‑OH vitamin D 22 ng/mL (low), calcium 9.2 mg/dL, phosphate 3.5 mg/dL. Insomnia Severity Index 14, TSH 2.1 mIU/L, Hb 13.2 g/dL.
She reports occasional difficulty falling asleep, denies eye pain or visual blur. On exam: pupils equal reactive, lids normal, no conjunctival injection.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
timolol 0.5% eye drops 1 gtt OD BD
latanoprost 0.005% eye drops 1 gtt OS HS
cholecalciferol 60000 IU PO once weekly for 8 weeks
melatonin 3 mg PO HS
trazodone 50 mg PO HS

memories.text: Messaged via app: Still waking up at 3 am most nights, feeling tired in the mornings. Eye drops fine, no irritation.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:

Evidence: IOP 17 OD, 18 OS; visual field stable; cup/disc 0.4. Serum 25‑OH vitamin D 38 ng/mL (now sufficient). Calcium 9.4, phosphate 3.6. Insomnia Severity Index 13, TSH 2.0, Hb 13.0.
She reports sleep onset still ~30 min, uses melatonin nightly. No ocular symptoms.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Referral to Dr. Lakshmi Narayan, Ophthalmology, for glaucoma assessment and possible surgical evaluation. Patient IOP consistently 15‑16 mmHg, visual field stable, cup/disc 0.4. No progression noted but long‑term monitoring advised.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Ophthalmology report: IOP 15 OD, 16 OS; visual field stable; optic disc cupping 0.4. No evidence of progression. Continue medical management. No surgery indicated at this time. Return to pulmonology for routine follow‑up.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Glaucoma, vitamin D deficiency, insomnia all well controlled.
Evidence: IOP 14 OD, 15 OS; visual field unchanged; cup/disc 0.4. Serum 25‑OH vitamin D 48 ng/mL. Calcium 9.7, phosphate 3.9. Insomnia Severity Index 7, TSH 1.9, Hb 13.5.
She denies any ocular symptoms, reports sleep latency <10 min, feels energetic. Advise to continue current regimen and review in 6 months.
